Position details:
UI Developer
Jersey City, NJ - Must be local
10 months, possible contract-to-hire
Job Description:
•    Looking for Senior UI web Developer 
•    10+ years experience. 
•    May assume senior architect role, developing and maintaining architectures. 
•    Provides vision, expertise and technology-based solutions in long range planning in the area of systems architecture. 
Position summary and key responsibilities:
•    Responsible for design and development of UI frameworks. 
•    Software developers design, code, test, debug and document programs as well as support activities for the corporate systems architecture. 
•    Works closely with business partners in defining requirements for system applications. 
•    We are looking for very strong JavaScript developer with extensive experience in building frame works and re-usable components, who are self-starters and eager learners. 
Required Skills Strong analytical skills:
•    6+ years of Java and Java Script development 
•    Must have J2EE knowledge and hands-on experience
•    Must be familiar and have strong experience in modern Java Script frameworks and libraries such as: jQuery/ Angular JS/Backbone JS/Node JS/Qunit, etc. 
•    Experience in CSS pre-processors such as Sass/Less/Stylus 
•    Experience in developing web services 
•    Experience in using Perforce/Subversion 
•    Strong UI development required
•    Must be quicker learner and take initiative
•    Strong verbal and written communication skills 
•    Excellent problem solving skills 
•    Detail and process oriented
